decisions.summary: The three revised magistracy sheets' captions are re-taken into feature 266's caption ledger instead of being seated by the one placer; the placer overhaul is deferred to future-work/compounds.md.
decisions.why: It narrows the accepted spec's Edge Case (a changed sheet is redrawn, measured and reviewed 'as any sheet edit') and cuts the enforcement of a GM request: 266 FR-013, from the GM's 'one placer for all labels', holds that revising a hand sheet re-seats ALL its captions, and 266's own D9 deferral of the non-board captions was ruled legitimate ONLY because the ledger forces the re-seat at the next revision. This is that next revision (the first since 266), and re-taking the ledger at it means the enforcement never fires - the carve-out defeats the purpose of the rule it excepts. None of the three grounds holds: not physically impossible (the defect is in seat_label.py, whose mechanism and four-part fix are written down and two parts were already made and measured); not implied by the GM's 267 words, which do not touch captions; and the literal rule does not defeat 267's purpose (the research is done either way). What remains is 'the literal reading needs more of the codebase changed', which is expressly not a ground. The recording is honest (plan, future-work with measurement, mechanism and sketch, commit message) but the ledger was re-taken in fe570972 BEFORE the exception was put to this review, contrary to the XVI procedure. Measured independently 2026-09-27 on scratch copies of the current sheets: two WRITE=1 passes left 17, 8 and 8 findings off seat (15, 6, 6 after a third - non-convergent) and self-tagged texts fell 16->5, 18->5, 22->3, so the mechanism claims stand; the plan's '12, 20 and 14' does not reproduce on the tree and should carry the sheet state it was taken on, and '42, 43 and 60 hand-set captions' are ledger findings, not captions (Ubame has 58 captions). Remedy: fix the placer's hand-sheet path per the sketch, seat the three sheets and drop their ledger entries; or put the exception to the GM for an explicit ruling before landing, not after.
